table.retrieve:
SELECT
	Distributor_ID=:as_distcode + REPLICATE(' ', 10 - LEN(:as_distcode)),
	SKU_ID=LTRIM(RTRIM(I.CustomICode)),
	Date_ID=Convert(VARCHAR(100), :ar_enddate, 112),
	SaleAble_Stock = SUM(
		CASE WHEN G.GodownGroupCode = 1 THEN CASE WHEN TYPE = 'OP' OR TYPE = 'PV' OR TYPE = 'SR' OR TYPE = 'RV' OR TYPE = 'AI' THEN +1 
		ELSE -1 END * (qty + bonus) ELSE 0 END), 
	Damage_Stock = SUM(
		CASE WHEN G.GodownGroupCode = 2 THEN CASE WHEN TYPE = 'OP' OR TYPE = 'PV' OR TYPE = 'SR' OR TYPE = 'RV' OR TYPE = 'AI' THEN +1 
		ELSE -1 END * (qty + bonus) ELSE 0 END),
	Expired_Stock = SUM(
		CASE WHEN G.GodownGroupCode = 3 THEN CASE WHEN TYPE = 'OP' OR TYPE = 'PV' OR TYPE = 'SR' OR TYPE = 'RV' OR TYPE = 'AI' THEN +1 
		ELSE -1 END * (qty + bonus) ELSE 0 END)
FROM
	(SELECT type='OP', icode, gcode, qty = sum(qty), bonus = 0
	FROM	
		(select pd.icode, pd.gcode,
			qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
				when 1 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
				when 2 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
				else pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty end, 0))
		FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd, item i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
			pl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			pd.icode=i.icode AND
			I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
		Group By pd.gcode, pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	pd.icode, pd.gcode, 
			qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
		FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd, item i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
			pl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			pd.icode=i.icode AND
			I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
		Group By pd.gcode, pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.gcode, 
			qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			  sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND sd.Due IS NULL AND
			sd.icode=i.icode AND
			I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
		Group By sd.gcode, sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.gcode, 
			qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			  sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode AND
			I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
		Group By sd.gcode, sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.gcode, 
			qty  = -sum(sd.qty)
		FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode AND
			I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
		Group By sd.gcode, sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.gcode, 
			qty  = sum(sd.qty)
		FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode AND
			I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
		Group By sd.gcode, sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.gcode, 
			qty = sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode AND
			I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
		Group By  sd.gcode, sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.gcode, 
			qty = -sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode AND
			I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
		Group By  sd.gcode, sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	d.icode, d.gcode, 
			qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d, item i
		WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
		      h.duesatisfydate < :ar_startdate AND
			d.icode=i.icode AND
			I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
		Group By  d.gcode, d.icode) A
	GROUP BY  gcode, icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PV',
		pd.icode, pd.gcode, 
		qty = sum(pd.looseqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN pd.bonusqty * pd.packunits
			when 2 THEN pd.bonusqty * pd.packunits
			else pd.bonusqty
			end, 0))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd, item i
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
		pl.date >= :ar_startdate and pl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		pd.icode=i.icode AND
		I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
	Group By  pd.gcode, pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PR',
		pd.icode, pd.gcode, 
		qty = sum(pd.looseqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(pd.bonusqty)
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd, item i
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
	      pl.date >= :ar_startdate and pl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		pd.icode=i.icode AND
		I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
	Group By  pd.gcode, pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SV',
		sd.icode, sd.gcode, 
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(sd.bonusqty)
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode AND
		I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
	Group By  sd.gcode, sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SR',
		sd.icode, sd.gcode, 
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(sd.bonusqty)
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode AND
		I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
	Group By  sd.gcode, sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='IV',
		sd.icode, sd.gcode, 
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		bonus = 0
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode AND
		I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
	Group By  sd.gcode, sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='DS',
		d.icode, d.gcode, 
		qty = sum(d.duesatisfyqty),
		bonus = 0
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d, item i
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode = d.duesatisfycode AND
	      h.duesatisfydate >= :ar_startdate and h.duesatisfydate <= :ar_enddate AND
		d.icode=i.icode AND
		I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
	Group By  d.gcode, d.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='RV',
		sd.icode, sd.gcode, 
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		bonus = 0
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode AND
		I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
	Group By  sd.gcode, sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AI',
		sd.icode, sd.gcode, 
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		bonus = 0
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode AND
		I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
	Group By  sd.gcode, sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AD',
		sd.icode, sd.gcode, 
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		bonus = 0
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode AND
		I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
	Group By  sd.gcode, sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT type='OP', icode,  godown.gcode, qty = 0, bonus = 0
	FROM ITEM, Godown WHERE Item.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) St, 
	Item i,
	Godown G
WHERE st.icode = i.icode AND St.GCode=G.GCode
GROUP BY i.name, i.customicode
ORDER BY i.customicode
